diff --git a/django/core/exceptions.py b/django/core/exceptions.py
index dc084b8692..6b5e4803d7 100644
--- a/django/core/exceptions.py
+++ b/django/core/exceptions.py
@@ -174,6 +174,14 @@ class ValidationError(Exception):
                     message %= error.params
                 yield str(message)
 
+    def __eq__(self, other):
+        if isinstance(other, ValidationError):
+            if hasattr(self, 'error_dict') and hasattr(other, 'error_dict'):
+                return self.message_dict == other.message_dict
+            elif hasattr(self, 'error_list') and hasattr(other, 'error_list'):
+                return sorted(self.messages) == sorted(other.messages)
+        return NotImplemented
+
     def __str__(self):
         if hasattr(self, 'error_dict'):
             return repr(dict(self))
diff --git a/docs/ref/exceptions.txt b/docs/ref/exceptions.txt
index ae2180ff9f..a1e78925a1 100644
--- a/docs/ref/exceptions.txt
+++ b/docs/ref/exceptions.txt
@@ -152,6 +152,11 @@ Django core exception classes are defined in ``django.core.exceptions``.
     :ref:`Model Field Validation <validating-objects>` and the
     :doc:`Validator Reference </ref/validators>`.
 
+    Two :exc:`ValidationError` instances are considered equal if they have the
+    same error messages, regardless of the order in which the errors were
+    raised. This applies both to errors raised for individual fields (using
+    ``error_dict``) and to non-field errors (using ``error_list``).
+
 ``NON_FIELD_ERRORS``
 ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
 
diff --git a/tests/test_exceptions/test_validation_error.py b/tests/test_exceptions/test_validation_error.py
index a0bbfaf77e..0388e2e15b 100644
--- a/tests/test_exceptions/test_validation_error.py
+++ b/tests/test_exceptions/test_validation_error.py
@@ -14,3 +14,48 @@ class TestValidationError(unittest.TestCase):
         message_dict['field2'] = ['E3', 'E4']
         exception = ValidationError(message_dict)
         self.assertEqual(sorted(exception.messages), ['E1', 'E2', 'E3', 'E4'])
+
+    def test_equality_with_same_messages(self):
+        self.assertEqual(ValidationError('Error message'), ValidationError('Error message'))
+
+    def test_equality_with_same_error_list(self):
+        self.assertEqual(
+            ValidationError(['Error 1', 'Error 2']),
+            ValidationError(['Error 1', 'Error 2'])
+        )
+
+    def test_equality_with_error_list_order_insensitive(self):
+        self.assertEqual(
+            ValidationError(['Error 1', 'Error 2']),
+            ValidationError(['Error 2', 'Error 1'])
+        )
+
+    def test_equality_with_same_error_dict(self):
+        self.assertEqual(
+            ValidationError({'field1': ['Error 1'], 'field2': ['Error 2']}),
+            ValidationError({'field1': ['Error 1'], 'field2': ['Error 2']})
+        )
+
+    def test_equality_with_error_dict_order_insensitive(self):
+        self.assertEqual(
+            ValidationError({'field1': ['Error 1', 'Error 2']}),
+            ValidationError({'field1': ['Error 2', 'Error 1']})
+        )
+
+    def test_inequality_with_different_messages(self):
+        self.assertNotEqual(ValidationError('Error 1'), ValidationError('Error 2'))
+
+    def test_inequality_with_different_error_lists(self):
+        self.assertNotEqual(
+            ValidationError(['Error 1', 'Error 2']),
+            ValidationError(['Error 1', 'Error 3'])
+        )
+
+    def test_inequality_with_different_error_dicts(self):
+        self.assertNotEqual(
+            ValidationError({'field1': ['Error 1']}),
+            ValidationError({'field1': ['Error 2']})
+        )
+
+    def test_inequality_with_different_types(self):
+        self.assertNotEqual(ValidationError('Error'), 'Error')
